title: Tunnel linking Derinkuyu and Kaymakli

tellings.quote: there's a tunnel that goes from Darren kuyu all the way to kimley whoa 5 and a half miles underground

plain: A tunnel runs about five and a half miles underground between Derinkuyu and Kaymakli, two ancient underground cities in Turkey. A researcher named Matt LaCroix says so on the show, without naming a source, as part of his case that something big happened in the deep past that drove people underground.
